entity.summary: UK-registered centralized digital-asset exchange linked to Babak Morteza Zanjani. OFAC designated Zedcex Exchange Ltd on 2026-01-30 under Iran-sector and counterterrorism authorities after identifying IRGC-linked transaction activity. Companies House later dissolved the UK company through compulsory strike-off on 2026-05-12, while public Zedcex-facing exchange surfaces remained accessible afterward. HEI therefore classifies the entity as limited rather than dead.
entity.notes: The launch date uses the UK company's incorporation date as the earliest authoritative public-lineage marker; no exact trading-launch date is asserted. OFAC identifies Zedcex as a UK-registered digital-asset exchange and states that it processed more than $94 billion in transactions after registration. Companies House records dissolution on 2026-05-12 under a section 1002A compulsory strike-off process tied to misleading, false, or deceptive incorporation information. Public Zedcex-facing exchange surfaces remained discoverable after dissolution, so death_reason and death_date remain null until operational cessation is directly established.

events.title: Zedcex UK corporate exchange lineage was established
events.description: Zedcex Exchange Ltd was incorporated in the United Kingdom on 2022-08-22. OFAC later identified Zedcex as a UK-registered digital-asset exchange and used the same establishment date in its sanctions record.
events.notes: This is a corporate-registration lineage marker, not a claim that trading necessarily opened on the same day.

events.title: OFAC designated Zedcex Exchange Ltd
events.description: The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control designated Zedcex Exchange Ltd pursuant to E.O. 13902 for operating in Iran's financial sector and pursuant to E.O. 13224, as amended, for materially supporting the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps.
events.notes: Treasury stated that Zedcex-attributed addresses processed funds for IRGC-linked wallets and that the exchange had processed more than $94 billion in transactions since registration.

events.title: Companies House dissolved Zedcex Exchange Ltd
events.description: Companies House recorded final compulsory strike-off and dissolution of Zedcex Exchange Ltd on 2026-05-12. The registrar's notice states that the section 1002A action related to incorporation information or statements considered misleading, false, or deceptive.
events.notes: Corporate dissolution is established, but operational shutdown is not. HEI preserves that distinction by keeping the entity limited with no death date.
